SELECT A.REG_CODE as prdRegistCode, A.ACCOUNT as prodId, ifnull(A.AGENCY_CODE,A.REGIST_BANK_CODE) as institutionCode, A.FUND_ACC_PLACE as areaCode, B.HOLDER_TYPE as holderType, A.CCY as ccy, A.PROD_VALUE as prodValue, A.IS_CONSIGN as isagency, sum(A.saleAmount) as daySaleAmountSum, sum(A.valueAmount) as dayValueAmountSum, sum(A.saleTotalByQty) as daySaleQtySum, sum(A.valueTotalByQty) as dayValueQtySum, sum(A.saleAmount) * A.PROD_VALUE as saleTotalByQty, sum(A.valueAmount) * A.PROD_VALUE as valueTotalByQty, #{batchDate} as equityConfDate FROM ( SELECT equsub.REG_CODE, equsub.ACCOUNT, equsub.FUND_ACC_PLACE, equsub.IS_CONSIGN, equsub.PROD_VALUE, equsub.INDENTIFY_MARK, equsub.REGIST_BANK_CODE, equsub.EQUITY_CONF_DATE, equsub.AGENCY_CODE, equsub.CCY, case when equsub.BUSI_TYPE in ('01','02','05','14','10') THEN equsub.AMOUNT ELSE 0 END AS saleAmount,
case when equsub.BUSI_TYPE in ('01','02','05','14','10') THEN equsub.AMOUNT when equsub.BUSI_TYPE in ('03','16','15','11') THEN equsub.AMOUNT * -1 ELSE 0 END AS valueAmount,
case when equsub.BUSI_TYPE in ('01','02','05','14','10') THEN equsub.SHARES ELSE 0 END AS saleTotalByQty,
case when equsub.BUSI_TYPE in ('01','02','05','14','10') THEN equsub.SHARES when equsub.BUSI_TYPE in ('03','16','15','11') THEN equsub.SHARES * -1 ELSE 0 END AS valueTotalByQty FROM CHB_EQUDET_SUB equsub left join CHB_PRD_BASEINFO baseinfo on equsub.ACCOUNT = baseinfo.PROD_ID WHERE equsub.STATUS != '03' and equsub.EQUITY_CONF_DATE = #{batchDate} and date_format(equsub.EQUITY_CONF_DATE, '%Y%m') <= date_format(ifnull(baseinfo.TERMINATEDATE,baseinfo.MDATE), '%Y%m')
union all
SELECT equsub.REG_CODE, equsub.ACCOUNT, equsub.FUND_ACC_PLACE, equsub.IS_CONSIGN, equsub.PROD_VALUE, equsub.INDENTIFY_MARK, equsub.REGIST_BANK_CODE, equsub.EQUITY_CONF_DATE, equsub.AGENCY_CODE, equsub.CCY, case when equsub.BUSI_TYPE in ('01','02','05','14','10') THEN equsub.AMOUNT ELSE 0 END AS saleAmount,
case when equsub.BUSI_TYPE in ('01','02','05','14','10') THEN equsub.AMOUNT when equsub.BUSI_TYPE in ('03','16','15','11') THEN equsub.AMOUNT * -1 ELSE 0 END AS valueAmount,
case when equsub.BUSI_TYPE in ('01','02','05','14','10') THEN equsub.SHARES ELSE 0 END AS saleTotalByQty,
case when equsub.BUSI_TYPE in ('01','02','05','14','10') THEN equsub.SHARES when equsub.BUSI_TYPE in ('03','16','15','11') THEN equsub.SHARES * -1 ELSE 0 END AS valueTotalByQty FROM CHB_EQUDET_SUB equsub left join CHB_PRD_BASEINFO baseinfo on equsub.ACCOUNT = baseinfo.PROD_ID WHERE equsub.STATUS != '03' and ifnull(baseinfo.TERMINATEDATE,baseinfo.MDATE) = #{batchDate} and date_format(equsub.EQUITY_CONF_DATE, '%Y%m') > date_format(STR_TO_DATE( #{batchDate} ,'%Y-%m-%d'), '%Y%m') ) A LEFT JOIN ( select INDENTIFY_MARK, ORG_INDENTIFY_MARK, REGIST_BANK_CODE, HOLDER_TYPE from (SELECT STATUS, INDENTIFY_MARK, ORG_INDENTIFY_MARK, REGIST_BANK_CODE, case when HOLDER_TYPE = '04' then '03' when HOLDER_TYPE = '05' then '04' when HOLDER_TYPE ='06' then '05' when HOLDER_TYPE ='07' then '06' when HOLDER_TYPE ='08' then '07' when HOLDER_TYPE ='09' then '08' when HOLDER_TYPE ='10' then '09' when HOLDER_TYPE in ('17','18','19','20','21','22','23') then '10' when HOLDER_TYPE in ('01','02','03') and HOLDER_CLASSIFY= '01' THEN '02' when HOLDER_TYPE in ('01','02','03') and HOLDER_CLASSIFY= '02' THEN '01' when HOLDER_TYPE in ('11','12','13','14','15','16','24','25','26') then '99' else '99' END as HOLDER_TYPE, ROW_NUMBER() over( partition by INDENTIFY_MARK order by UPDATE_TIME desc ) indMarkNo FROM CHB_EQU_SUB ) T where indMarkNo = 1 and STATUS != '03' ) B on A.INDENTIFY_MARK = B.INDENTIFY_MARK GROUP BY A.REG_CODE, A.ACCOUNT, ifnull(A.AGENCY_CODE,A.REGIST_BANK_CODE), A.FUND_ACC_PLACE, B.HOLDER_TYPE, A.CCY, A.PROD_VALUE, A.IS_CONSIGN
SELECT COUNT(*) from CHB_EQUDET_SUB WHERE EQUITY_CONF_DATE = #{batchDate}
